14. 一條幼細的繩子的長度量得 25 m，準確至最接近的 m。若將該繩分割為 n 條，使每條的長度均量得 5 cm，準確至最接近的 cm，求 n 的最大可取值。
A. 445
B. 566
C. 567
D. 650
reasoning: The rope length L is in [2450 cm, 2550 cm). Each piece length l is in [4.5 cm, 5.5 cm). For n pieces the total length lies in [4.5n, 5.5n). Overlap with [2450, 2550) requires 4.5n < 2550 → n ≤ 566 and 5.5n > 2450 → n ≥ 446. Hence the largest integer n satisfying both is 566, which corresponds to option B.
